description_en: Retrieves the host accounts associated with a host shared key
description_zh: 获取主机共享密钥关联的主机账号
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts-for-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostAccountsForHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host shared key.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number of the returned results. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The Settings for the paged query determine the number of host accounts associated with the host shared key to return on each page during paging. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 host accounts associated with the host shared key are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的主机共享密钥关联的主机账号的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条主机共享密钥关联的主机账号
parameters.name: page_size

HostAccounts.description_zh: 主机共享密钥关联的主机账号的列表
